value.name: Asha shields the table from him
value.description: Asha positions her body between the boy and the table where the pad had been, signaling guarded control of the situation.
evidence: She kept her body angled between him and the table where the pad had been

value.name: Asha asks about cutting toast
value.description: Asha speaks in a deliberately ordinary tone and asks whether the boy wants his toast cut in halves or quarters.
evidence: asked him, in the ordinary voice she used for ordinary mornings, whether he wanted the toast cut in halves or in quarters

value.name: Asha receives Rosa's first message
value.description: As she crosses the kitchen, Asha reads a buzzed phone message from Rosa instructing her to get the signature and clear the board.
evidence: Her phone buzzed once against her hip on the way across the linoleum, Rosa again, and she read it without slowing—contact and status received, kids are there, get the signature and clear the board

value.name: Asha releases the boy at the counter
value.description: Asha lets go of the boy's shoulder only when he is close enough to reach the counter and take a glass himself.
evidence: let her hand drop from the boy's shoulder only when he was close enough to the counter to reach for a glass on his own

value.name: Claire silently acknowledges the situation
value.description: Claire hears what is happening, does not turn around, and chooses to keep doing the task she has been given.
evidence: Claire, at the stove, did not turn around; she lifted the kettle off the burner a beat before it whistled, which told Asha that Claire had heard everything and was choosing, for now, the one task she had been given

value.name: Asha serves toast and reveals the form
value.description: Asha places toast at the boy's elbow and slides the authorization form from under the plate so it lands in front of Claire.
evidence: Asha set a plate of toast at the boy's elbow, halves not quarters because he had nodded at halves, and in the same motion she slid the authorization form out from under the plate's edge so the top sheet came to rest in front of Claire at the corner of the counter

value.name: Asha places the pen beside the form
value.description: Asha sets a pen next to the authorization form without looking at it, keeping her attention on the boy.
evidence: The pen she set beside it she did not look at; she kept her eyes on the boy

value.name: Asha receives Rosa's second message
value.description: Asha reads another urgent message from Rosa telling her to put the paper in front of Claire immediately and then turns the phone face-down.
evidence: Her phone buzzed once against her hip and she read it without lifting it far from her side—Rosa, the line short, the words get the paper in front of her now, no gaps, clear the board—and then turned the screen face-down on the counter near the sugar bowl
